svg.title: urna ask: the answer and its citation
svg.desc: urna, end to end: urna setup on an empty machine (scan, plan, the offline embedder payload, the python env, the doctor checks), then urna tui: open a corpus, ask it, read the cited answer, check the install, quit. Steps: 1 · ask: a question in, the passage and its citation out / 2 · cite: the citation back to the stored text and its hashes

g.text: $ urna ask quickstart.urna 'how do citations wo
$ urna ask quickstart.urna 'how do citations work'
$ urna ask quickstart.urna 'how do citations work' -k
$ urna ask quickstart.urna 'how do citations work' -k 1
because the citation points at content, two people who build the same logical corpus on two machines
get the same citation, and a stored corpus and a compressed one cite identically. resolving a citat
ion returns the exact canonical text and the original byte span it came from, which is what lets an
agent quote a source it can prove.

svg.text: urna ask: the answer and its citation

cite: the citation back to the stored text and its hashes
